facts.text: Joseph's corner, recording every word Gina says.
facts.why: Joseph does watch Gina, his ex, from his café corner. The pages read don't say he records her words.
facts.fix: Joseph's corner, never far from Gina.

vibe.verdict: A well-observed Café des 2 Moulins that gets the brûlée, the gnome and the glass man, with only a slight stretch on Joseph.
missing: Raspberries on her fingertips (Amélie at the greengrocer)

The girl with the glass of water (the Renoir painting)
Madeleine Wallace and the love letter
